Quartermaster Talli is a human Harper quartermaster at the Last Light Inn in Act Two.
“
If you're all right by Jaheira, you're all right by me.
„
— Talli

Involvement

Act Two

Last Light Inn

Talli is in Last Light Inn's courtyard during at X: -30 Y: 128, managing the Harpers' supplies.

If  Marcus is exposed as a True Soul, Talli gets  Stunned and joins the fight against his summoned  Crawling Claws.

Resolve the Abduction

When  Marcus attacks the inn and attempts to kidnap  Isobel during Resolve the Abduction, Talli always fails the save and is  Impaled for the remainder of the battle. If Isobel is not saved, she and everyone in Last Light Inn turn into  Shadow-Cursed Undead, save for  Jaheira.

Assault Moonrise Towers

If Isobel is saved at the Last Light Inn, and once the  Nightsong is freed from her cage and heads for Moonrise, Talli follows Jaheira to Moonrise Towers. There, she survives the initial off-screen assault, and moves near the entrance. She still can be traded with.

Talli does not usually partake in the ensuing battle within Moonrise Towers itself. However, after the ensuing assault within Moonrise Towers' hall, Talli moves in and starts salvaging the equipment and remains there until the very end of Act Two.

Bugs

It is not necessary to long rest at camp for this to occur; Reported by several Steam users.
